description: Shortcut to list all available metric names for a fully-specified location — supply all five levels (theme, sub_theme, topic, geography_type, geography) at once rather than calling navigate iteratively. Returns metric names like "COVID-19_cases_casesByDay" ready to pass to get_metric_data.(theme, sub_theme, topic, geography_type, geography), without walking each level. Returns metric names like "COVID-19_cases_casesByDay" or "COVID-19_deaths_ONSByDay" ready to pass to get_metric_data.
name: list_metrics
